description: Classification spec §4. The digit means the same thing under every type prefix: it measures the claim's evidentiary posture, not the industry the publisher sits in. Version 6 names the scale's six-value form, introduced when grade 5 (classification spec pre-3.9) split into 5 (relay, primary unreachable) and 6 (unattributed assertion) at v3.9.

members.name: Direct, fully evidenced
members.meaning: The source saw it and showed its work. You can check the artifacts.

members.name: Direct, partially evidenced
members.meaning: The source saw it but did not publish enough for you to check.

members.name: Direct, aggregate
members.meaning: The source saw it in data only it holds. Nobody outside can reproduce the number.

members.name: Relay, primary identified
members.meaning: The source is repeating a named finding it did not observe. You can go read the primary.

members.name: Relay, primary unreachable
members.meaning: Someone is named as having found this and no document behind them can be opened. Also where the chain runs two or more removes deep.

members.name: Unattributed assertion
members.meaning: Nothing stands behind this but the assertion. No observation described, no origin named, or the only party vouching for it is the party it benefits.

6: the 5/6 split itself: grade 5 (relay, primary unreachable) is new at this version, formed by splitting what pre-3.9 called grade 5 into today's 5 and 6
